title: Secrets, certificates, encryption and key custody design
workflow: Inventory credential and key usage by service and environment
Classify risks and regulatory/participant cryptographic constraints
Select managed vault or HSM boundary under qualified review
Authorize least-privilege retrieval and nonexportable keys as required
Rotate, revoke and recover through witnessed procedures
Log access anomalies without exposing raw secret material
invariants: No secrets in Git, ZIP documentation, client JS or general logs
Bank signing algorithms cannot be guessed from public ISO message names
Production and test key hierarchies must not share material
Emergency key access is time-limited and independently reviewed
Compromised credentials require revocation and incident response
Do not claim HSM conformance without vendor/participant evidence
planned_tests: Secret rotated without exposing plaintext in logs
approval_gate: Institution cryptographic policy, approved HSM/rail security specs, qualified CISO and executed key rotation tests.
